generation.gooo_source:
package offset
namespace offset
entity Integer id "offset://integer"
entity Summary id "offset://summary" fields {
    field value id "offset://summary/value" type integer required one
    field positive id "offset://summary/positive" type boolean required one
    field label id "offset://summary/label" type string required one
}
activity Add(Integer) -> Integer computes "return (input + 1)"
activity Describe(Integer) -> Summary computes "return Summary{value: (input), positive: (input > 0), label: (\"assembled\")}" assembling {
    baseline "return Summary{value: 0, positive: false, label: \"pending\"}"
    picked "value" -> "value_second"
    picked "positive" -> "value_second"
    picked "label" -> "value_second"
    choice "value" field_value at "0" alternative "input" intent "받은 값을 보존한다. Preserve the received integer."
    choice "positive" field_value at "1" alternative "input > 0" intent "양수인지 표시한다. Mark whether the value is positive."
    choice "label" field_value at "2" alternative "\"assembled\"" intent "조립된 결과로 표시한다. Label the result assembled."
    value_case "[3]" -> "{\"label\":\"assembled\",\"positive\":true,\"value\":3}"
    value_case "[-2]" -> "{\"label\":\"assembled\",\"positive\":false,\"value\":-2}"
    attempts "8"
}
bind Add.result -> Describe.input
